A 403 CSRF failure right after moving the form into a partial usually means the hx-post no longer carries the token: a `{% csrf_token %}` in the base template only helps if it is inside the form that is posted. Two usual fixes are putting `{% csrf_token %}` inside the partial's `<form>`, or sending the token for all htmx requests with `hx-headers='{"X-CSRFToken": "{{ csrf_token }}"}'` on the body tag. I haven't seen your templates, so I'm not sure which case it is.
Action: Check the partial and the base template in trailmix to see where the token and the hx-post sit, then apply the matching fix.
